content:
Maya: Quick heads-up — after kernel-v2.2 rolled we saw a 12-20% p95 increase for Mixtral MoE routes with top_k>=64. Repro on prod-cpu4 and dedicated cluster.
Ash: Any profiler traces?
Maya: Pushed perf trace — here's the top lines:
```
router_softmax: 4.12ms
router_gather: 2.05ms
kv_lookup: 1.1ms
expert_kernel(conv_slice): 9.8ms
total_token_time: 18.2ms
GPU util: 73%
``` 
Leo: Hmm looks like kernel selection flipped to kernel-slicer for seq<128 after the optimizer patch. That increases per-expert kernel launch overhead with many small experts. Can you paste kernel map?
Maya: kernel map:
```
seq<=32 -> fast-vec-kernel
32<seq<=128 -> kernel-slicer-v2
seq>128 -> fused-attn
``` 
Devon: On Mixtral MoE, we often get worse perf when expert parallelism is too high + kernel-slicer. Try EXPERT_MAX_PARALLEL=6 and lower top_k to 32 for heavy routes. I tested on canary:
```
before: p95=210ms top_k=64 parallel=12
after:  p95=178ms top_k=32 parallel=6
``` 
Sahil: KV cache churn looks correlated — eviction rate spiked 3x around the same time. Eviction log:
```
evict_rate: 0.27 -> 0.83
kv_hit: 68% -> 41%
``` 
Ash: If KV hit drops, router ends up sending more cold-expert calls -> kernel startup overheads. Two knobs: raise kv_cache_size for Mixtral pools, or enable probabilistic top-k routing (stochastic_topk=true) to reduce tail by sampling. 
Leo: Stochastic_topk experiment results (50k requests):
```
stochastic=false p99=420ms p95=200ms
stochastic=true  p99=340ms p95=190ms
``` 
Maya: Also saw RoPE scaling artifacts — with rope_scale=0.9 logits variance increased and router softmax got sharper; lowering softmax_temp=0.8 smoothed it and reduced expert imbalance.
Devon: Action items:
- revert kernel-slicer rollout for mixtral-moe-pool to kernel-slicer-v1
- run canary with EXPERT_MAX_PARALLEL=6 + top_k=32 + stochastic_topk=true
- increase kv_cache_size by 20% for canary
- add kernel-launch metrics to runtime-metrics (latency histograms per kernel)
Maya: I'll open a PR with canary config and a perf dashboard. @runtime-bot started deploy job 2358765450 :rocket:
runtime-bot: deploy/mixtral-canary initiated by maya (job id j-9923) :white_check_mark:
Ash: Nice. If canary looks good, we should roll with a staged ramp and keep kernel-slicer-v2 behind feature flag for small-seq workloads.
Leo: Also add a knob in optimizer to prefer fused kernels when expert_count>16.
Devon: I'll capture flamegraphs and attach later, + perf traces (perf_id: perf-2358765478)
Maya: Thanks team — will post results here. :thumbsup:
